app.name: XCHK Verification
app.short_description: Live video identity verification for Zendesk tickets. Verify location, authenticate devices, and sync PASS/FAIL results.
app.long_description:
XCHK Verification lets Zendesk agents launch a live video verification session directly from a ticket sidebar. The app verifies the requester's real-time location against their expected location and checks device authenticity including browser language/timezone spoofing and VPN/proxy detection.

After the session, PASS or FAIL results are posted back to the Zendesk ticket as an internal note with tags, and can trigger Zendesk automations. When Zendesk OAuth is connected in XCHK, results sync automatically back to the ticket.

Key features:
- One-click launch from the ticket sidebar
- Live video stream with mobile device capture
- GPS and IP location verification
- Device authentication (browser language, timezone, VPN/proxy detection)
- Automated PASS/FAIL sync to Zendesk tickets
- No Zendesk API calls from the sidebar — all through ZAF SDK

**Privacy & Data Disclosure**

This app accesses the following data from your Zendesk account:
- **Ticket ID** — used to associate the verification session with the correct ticket.
- **Requester email** — used to identify the customer being verified and create their verification session.
- **Requester phone** (optional) — used to send an SMS verification link to the customer.
- **Account subdomain** — used to route API calls to the correct Zendesk instance.

All data is transmitted securely to the XCHK server (xchk.io) via HTTPS. During a verification session, the following data is captured and stored on XCHK:
- **Screenshots and video stills** of the requester taken during the live verification session.
- **IP address** and network details including ISP, ASN, connection type, and VPN/proxy detection results.
- **GPS coordinates** from the requester's mobile device (when granted).
- **Device information** including device type, browser language, and timezone settings.

The requester's email, phone, ticket ID, and subdomain are stored alongside the session data for the duration of the verification session (typically less than 10 minutes). After the session completes, all data remains stored on XCHK for audit and compliance purposes under the XCHK Terms of Service.

No data is sold, shared with third parties, or used for any purpose other than identity verification. XCHK uses Zendesk OAuth solely to post internal notes and tags back to tickets — XCHK never reads ticket contents, agent data, or other customer records.

For full details, see the XCHK Privacy Policy at https://xchk.io/privacy.
app.installation_instructions:
1. In XCHK helpdesk, open **API & Webhooks → Integrations** and generate an API key.

2. In Zendesk Admin → **Apps and integrations → Zendesk Support apps**, install XCHK Verification.

3. Set the **XCHK integrator token** to the API key from step 1 (secure field).

4. Set **XCHK base URL** to `https://in.xchk.io` (or your XCHK host).

5. Optionally set **Zendesk subdomain override** if auto-detection fails.

6. In XCHK, go to **API & Webhooks → Zendesk** and connect OAuth to enable automatic PASS/FAIL ticket sync.
